question: Under what temporal condition are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: A practice is said to be done for one year.
The condition is when that practice has been practiced.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The specific practice is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When it has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
